hub.building.longhouse.info: Your family’s quarters: kin, heirs and fosterlings.
hub.building.meadHall.info: News, rumours, legends and hired swords.
hub.building.smithy.info: Better armour and weapons for the whole host.

hub.counsel.title: Hirdmaster’s Counsel
hub.counsel.unread: {count, plural, one {An important message waits} other {# important messages wait}} in your inbox.
hub.counsel.fleetAway: Your fleet is at sea under {leader} with {men} men.
hub.counsel.iced: Ice locks the harbour until {thaw}, {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} from now. No ship can put out before the thaw.
hub.counsel.waitThaw: Wait for the thaw ({days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}})
hub.counsel.foodLow: The stores hold food for only {months} months. See to the food before hunger comes.
hub.counsel.noShips: No ship lies in the harbour. Order one at the Shipyard before you sail.
hub.counsel.noMen: No warriors stand at the hall. Send the war-arrow to muster men.
hub.counsel.plan: The sea is open: {ships, plural, one {a ship lies} other {# ships lie}} ready and {men} men stand at home. Plan an expedition to trade or raid abroad.
hub.counsel.idleMen: {silver} silver sits in the treasury. The war-arrow could raise up to {men} {unit} now.
hub.counsel.idleShip: The treasury could pay for a new {shipType} ({cost} silver) at the Shipyard.
hub.counsel.mustering: {men, plural, one {# recruit is} other {# recruits are}} gathering at the hall, arriving {arrive}.
hub.counsel.shipBuilding: The shipwrights are building a {shipType}, ready {done}{count, plural, one {} other { (# ships in the queue)}}.
hub.counsel.annual.allthing: The Allthing gathers in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ({date}).
hub.counsel.annual.harvest: Harvest begins in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ({date}).
hub.counsel.annual.yule: Yule is {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} away ({date}).
hub.voyage.title: First voyage
hub.voyage.done: Your first voyage is done. The Counsel will guide you from here.
hub.voyage.hint.thaw: Ice holds the harbour. Pass the days at home until it breaks.
hub.voyage.hint.muster: Raise more warriors in the Great hall, or sail with the men you have.
hub.voyage.hint.plan: Choose leaders, ships, men and food in the planner, then Launch.
hub.voyage.hint.sail: On the sea chart, pick a known harbour, press Sail and let time run.
hub.voyage.hint.deed: At the harbour, trade at the docks or raid it.
hub.voyage.hint.home: Press Sail home. Plunder goes to your Market, ready to sell.
hub.time.title: Time at home
hub.time.note: At the hall, time waits for your word. Waiting stops early when something needs you.
hub.planner.crewLine: {men, plural, one {# man} other {# men}} aboard. The ships need {min} to {max}.
hub.planner.crewNoShips: {men, plural, one {# man} other {# men}} ready. Choose a ship to carry them.
hub.planner.benches: The ships have benches for {max, plural, one {# man} other {# men}}.
hub.planner.fromTown: Taken from the town's own food
hub.planner.foodFor: {days, plural, =0 {No food for the crew} one {Food for # day} other {Food for # days}}

hub.planner.townKeeps: The town keeps {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}
hub.planner.noCargo: No trade goods lie in the storehouse.
hub.planner.ready: All is ready. Launch puts the fleet to sea.
hub.counsel.quiet: All is quiet. The hall waits for your word.
hub.hall.rules: {ruler} rules from {place}, over {holdings, plural, one {one holding} other {# holdings}}.
hub.hall.men: {total, plural, one {# warrior serves} other {# warriors serve}} you; {home, plural, =0 {none of them is at home} one {# is at home} other {# are at home}}.
hub.hall.ships: {total, plural, =0 {You have no ships.} one {You have one ship; {home, plural, =0 {it is away} other {it lies in the harbour}}.} other {You have # ships, {home} of them in the harbour.}}
hub.hall.food: Food at home lasts {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
hub.muster.farmsNote: {n, plural, =0 {No one left to answer} one {# more could answer} other {# more could answer}}
hub.muster.treasuryLimit: The treasury can pay for {n, plural, one {# man} other {# men}}.
hub.muster.cost: {men, plural, one {# man} other {# men}} for {bounty} silver now and {wages} silver a month. They arrive on {date}.
hub.muster.none: {men} men on the farms will answer the war-arrow.
hub.muster.pick: Move the handle to call men from the farms.
hub.planner.onFootLine: No ships. Each man carries food for up to {days} days; together they can carry {tons} t of food and plunder.
hub.planner.marchLine: {men, plural, =0 {No one marches yet.} one {# man marches.} other {# men march.}}
hub.planner.carryFull: The men can carry no more.
hub.planner.readyMarch: All is ready. March out leads the war-band from the gates.
hub.planner.readyMarchIced: All is ready. The sea is iced in, but the roads are open: march out now.
hub.planner.marchInIce: The roads are open: choose March overland to set out now.
hub.counsel.march: The sea is shut, but the roads are not: a war-band can march overland now.
hub.interior.greatHall.hirdmaster.name: The Hirdmaster
hub.interior.greatHall.hirdmaster.greeti: I keep your high seat warm. Say the word and the men will gather.
hub.interior.greatHall.steward.name: The Steward
hub.interior.greatHall.steward.greeting: Every coin in this chest is counted, and counted twice.
hub.interior.greatHall.lawspeaker.name: The Lawspeaker
hub.interior.greatHall.lawspeaker.greeti: The folk have their say through me. Hear them, and the land stays quiet.
hub.interior.smithy.smith.name: The Smith
hub.interior.smithy.smith.greeting: The iron is hot. Tell me what your men should carry.
hub.interior.shipyard.shipwright.name: The Shipwright
hub.interior.shipyard.shipwright.greetin: Give me oak, iron and a winter, and I will give you a ship.
hub.interior.shipyard.strand.name: Ships on the strand
hub.interior.shipyard.strand.greeting: Your ships lie drawn up on the shingle. Here they are tarred, caulked and mended.
hub.interior.shipyard.yard: {place}: shipyard tier {tier}, {slots, plural, one {# slipway} other {# slipways}}.
hub.interior.market.merchant.name: The Merchant
hub.interior.market.merchant.greeting: Furs, salt, iron, amber. Name the good, and we will find the price.
hub.interior.meadHall.keeper.name: The Hall-keeper
hub.interior.meadHall.keeper.greeting: Sit, drink, listen. Every word that comes up the fjord passes my counter.
hub.interior.meadHall.travellers.name: The Travellers
hub.interior.meadHall.travellers.greetin: Pull up a bench. We have come a long way, and we talk better with a cup.
hub.interior.meadHall.sellswords.name: The Sellswords
hub.interior.meadHall.sellswords.greetin: Our blades are for hire, for one season or for as long as the silver lasts.
hub.interior.steward.gain: This month should bring in {silver} silver more than it costs.
hub.interior.steward.loss: This month will cost {silver} silver more than it brings in.
hub.interior.steward.even: This month should pay for itself, and no more.
hub.interior.lawspeaker.line: Taxes, building, the garrison and the folk’s petitions at {place} wait on your word.
